framework_lessons: Political incentives need independent policy and timing tests.
assessment: The report anticipated 2022 market stress and regulatory action, but its China rebound, durable negative-real-rate ceiling, and current crypto-cycle optimism were materially weaker. The Ethereum withdrawal timing is technically wrong. The local CPI peak should receive narrower credit without confusing it with the final annual peak.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
